REPOSITORY ATLAS / PRIVACY

Privacy, clearly.

Repository Atlas is a static, independent tool for viewing public GitHub repository data. It does not require an account.

What the app does

When you submit a public repository URL, your browser sends requests directly to GitHub’s public REST API for repository details, language totals, and recent commits. GitHub receives the requested repository and ordinary request information, such as your IP address and browser details. See GitHub’s privacy statement.

Hosting data

Vercel serves this website and may process operational request information, including IP addresses, request times, and device or browser information, under its privacy notice. The existing ChatGPT Sites deployment, if visited separately, is hosted by OpenAI and subject to its own policies.

What this project stores

The application does not create visitor accounts, set its own cookies, use local storage, run analytics or advertising scripts, or keep a database of searches. Hosting and API providers may retain operational data under their own policies.

Independent project

Repository Atlas is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub, Vercel, Netflix, Meta, or Anthropic. Public repository content remains the responsibility of its respective owners.
